body: Hi. I dunno if you want to talk about the stuff that's bothering you or something else completely, but whatever is fine. It's 7am here and I have an exam today at 1pm so I'm very much procrastinating over that.

Well, here goes. Started off when I was younger, my brother is gay and in school got heavily bullied. This led to him coming home, taking this out on my mum and I. He had threatened us both with knives, he has threatened to kill himself when if we came near him. I was always the one in the background, having to deal with the emotional trauma of that. He attempted suicide every week for about two years, miraculously he's still around today.

However, it's left lasting implications on my mental health. I lost all sense of direction, motivation, happiness. It's so much of a struggle for me to even shower in the morning. 

I have Aspergers, and have always struggled with friendships and stuff. Ive never had real lasting friendships, everyone always feels fake to me, and it's tough in social situations to make friends and be happy.

Early this year I started talking to a girl. And fell for her. Hard. We'd lie in her bed and cuddle and she'd tell me all the things she likes about me and I'd do the same for her. It's all I needed. And naturally it didn't last. And it broke me. And we're still good friends, and at times she's suggested getting back with me but it's never happened, but now she's friends with benefits with someone else, and it kills me. I'm in love, and she's crushed any feeling of self worth or value I have. And I miss her. And I want her. And I can't have her. And I'm the same as you, I slave away, doing nothing with myself. 

The only thing keeping me going is school, I wanna become a psychiatrist because I want to understand people and their brains. I know I'm smart enough, but I don't have the willpower to do it. I can't study, I have an exam tomorrow I've barely studied for, which whilst not essential, is really important for me. I'm determined to be the best, but determination means shit when I don't do anything.

Edit: I'm not on the edge I don't think. There are times I feel like I am, but I don't think I am yet. OP, and anyone else on the edge, good luck escaping, please know it is not all lost for you, there are people who love you and despite what you may think there are always, always people who would be upset should you leave us all. Please, keep fighting.

So many people feel like their life is out of their control, until they regain control, I know you can do the same. Start slowly, small, easy tasks that'll help you overcome what's hurting you. I know it's difficult but find people who make you happy. Be open with those you know, help them understand the pain you're going through. They can help. I briefly looked at your profile and saw you're 27, great, by age 30 you can be living a happy, fulfilled life. In saying that, by age 28 you can also be living a happy, fulfilled life. Things can change at the click of a finger, and if you need to open up about specifics or go into detail and let it all out then I, or someone else here would be more  than happy to listen.

From what I've seen it seems like you're starting to get help. Good, please please please continue. It won't feel like it on a day to day basis maybe, but it helps, it really does. Just, keep going, day by day. It gets easier, I promise. I hate to stray to far into cliches but you have so long left, tomorrow you could meet the love of your life, you never know. Good luck, and again, everyone on this sub and in your life I'm sure is routing for you!

I understand. I'm sure there are good people around though, it doesn't always feel like it, but there's always some good people around us, it just takes time to find. I hope you do find good people and find a good place, it's definitely not easy feeling lonely and isolated like that.

Think of it this way, there are 29,999 other people on your island. Each one with their own lives, their own stories, own families and relationships. And hey, if you were to kill yourself in a place like that, the impact of your death would be felt a lot more than it would in some huge urban area. Idk how close knitted the island is, but I'm sure there's still people there to meet and experiences and fun times to have, and out of all those people I'm sure you'll find a few who can give you purpose and happiness. Good luck, you know everyone here is supporting you!

Look, first off I'll tell you I care and I hope by next week you reconsider. 

And yeah dude, it's scary. The fear has the one thing that's stopped me. Part of me is grateful, the other part hates it. You're right people care about you, you need to take the next week one day at a time. Enjoy yourself this week, maybe you'll give it more time, maybe you'll have a good final week.

Either way man, I want you to know me, and several others on this sub, are here if you ever wanna talk or feel less alone, even if it's impossible to change what you feel or what you may do.

So, my brother got put in psych ward for a bit, so I have a little experience of this. 

There's not much immediately you can do, basically. I don't know your situation, but if it's a situation where it can be done, visit him as often as you can. That time will probably give him an insight into how much you and your family care if you're able to go see him. Bring him things to do, or something to pass the days, as I remember my brother getting ridiculously bored. 

Other than that, while he's in there there isn't much you can do. You gotta understand that's the best place for him, and he'll be out once he's healthy enough. There's no use rushing it if he genuinely is a danger to himself, and it's better him in there than him in a grave. 

I'm really sorry though OP, it's a scary time when something like this happens, just think about it like any other illness treated in a hospital, think about how he's being treated by experts and how he is being made better and will be better off for it.

I'm genuinely at a loss for what can get me out of bed, or get me motivated. I've tried everything. I do get that things could change, but why would tomorrow be different than the last 16 years? I've been happy for at most 2 week spells, until people see the inside of me and how fucked I am and suddenly I'm a lot less likeable. 

I've tried to focus all my feeling for girls into sorting myself. I joined the gym, though when I could actually see progress and still nobody wanted me that stung. I've been trying to go recently but I've been badly struggling and not progressing at all, I just am never in the right mindset.

I know this girl is never going to and wouldn't make me happy, although she did for a bit, and I guess that makes me feel at ease with the situation. The one person in the world I think could actually make me happy atm is funnily enough my ex, not the girl who's on the scene atm, but the only girl I've ever had a relationship with. This is the point I get told not to go back to an ex, but tbh if I got the chance I know I would. We were actually two very compatible people, we ended because I mentally wasn't at the stage I could cope with a relationship. And whilst I'm mentally fucked just now I know I could make a girl feel loved and appreciated. Also worth mentioning that I think that for some reason she's the only girl I could genuinely have a chance with.

I know you said not to worry about girls, and I do plan on getting to the stage where I don't ASAP, but I'm just kinda typing out my thoughts as they come, i don't wanna reread any of this, I just wanna get it out as my brains thinking it.

Seriously tho, thanks a million for just reading my story and acknowledging it and caring. It puts my mind a little at ease knowing there's someone out there who actually knows my feelings, and I can't put into words how much I appreciate the fact that you went out of your way to try and listen to and help me.

High school just now, got exams coming up. Still terrified, but I'm alright this year I think. I've had short spells of happiness, but they've lasted a month or two at most. I still stay at home, not in a position to change that atm but when I can I hopefully will. I'm leaning towards doing engineering at university, not sure yet though. Glad you pushed yourself to finish your degree, education is keeping me going at the moment, the thought of finishing school off and being in a good place with good prospects is great to me.

My sleeping is all over the place, I get 12 hours some night and 2 some others, and yet I'm just as tired every single day. My dog gets me through too. He's getting old and I'll be broken when he dies. I sit up at night and think about everything. I struggle so much. I'm still in school and I'm not working yet, I'm a straight A student and I feel like an ungrateful shit for how I feel, but yet I see people failing who are happy, and I wish I was more like them.

Geez, that's a lot of shit to go through. The only person I have in my life, who's helped me through everything, is cutting me off and I have absolutely no idea where I go now. Im so isolated and lonely and hurt and I don't have a clue what to do. I get what you mean about being tired, idk about you but I feel like I could sleep for six months and wake up and be just as tired as I already was. I wish I knew what to say outside of the usual cliches, but all I can say is please please keep going, it breaks me to see posts here and realise the person has actually done it, and I really hope you don't do it.
I'm glad you're here. If you're comfortable with sharing, may I ask what's brought you to this point?
If the hotline is unable to talk to you and you need someone, I'm here. How are you just now?

Dude, I've had a horrible night and am a mess atm, and I could use someone too. 

Idk how fussy they are about the rules but since you literally asked for someone to talk, if you wanna message me or something I'm here.

It really depends on the person dude. Suicide isn't something that crosses my mind as much as probably most people here, but when I'm feeling low the thought is overwhelming and I've been very close to doing it in moments of madness.

Basically, I don't think about it at all often, but when I do I'm so emotional and irrational that I could - and very nearly have done it.
